description: This PHP source file sets up and renders the 'AuditTrailList' page for the 'Settings' module in the vtiger CRM system. It includes configuration of Smarty templates, assigns several global variables and module strings, determines audit trail status, and displays the corresponding template.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: A Smarty wrapper class configured for vtiger CRM templates.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the specified Smarty template to the browser.
